payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear rationale for using word overlap via the F1 score instead of an exact match when comparing entities, highlighting the need to account for different naming conventions for the same entity.

claims.text: F1 is used instead of exact match to check if entities are the same because predictions may mention the same entity with different names, avoiding false positives in detecting invalid questions.
The F1 score allows for word overlap, which is essential for determining if two mentions refer to the same entity, rather than requiring an exact match.
